fields.acceptance: A testscript logs a node touched by three change sets: --limit 2 gives two change sets, a next_cursor and a 'next: rhiza log <ref> --limit 2 --cursor <c>' line, and that cursor's page holds the third with no next_cursor; --all gives all three; --limit 0, --limit 1001 and a bad cursor exit 2; log --json and api call log print the same bytes; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza log pages its change sets in apply order with --limit (1 to 1000, default 100) and an opaque --cursor, returns next_cursor while more remain and ends its text with a next: line, and --all returns every change set; target and view come on every page

fields.acceptance: A test pages a roadmap whose group is split by --limit and sees the group's kind and intent repeated on the next page, with every change set appearing exactly once across the pages, including a change set that serves two milestones and sits in two groups; --all matches the concatenated pages; a bad cursor and an out-of-range limit exit 2; a roadmap of more than 100 change sets is read whole by health's roadmap check and the roadmap app; roadmap --json and api call roadmap print the same bytes; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza roadmap pages its change sets in group order (milestones, then backlog, then umbrellas; depends-on order within a group) with --limit, --cursor and --all; a page holds only the groups with change sets on it, a group split across pages repeats its kind and intent, and health's roadmap check, the roadmap TUI app and the model app's roadmap tab read it with all

fields.acceptance: A test walks a node with decisions, sources and change sets and pages it with a --limit that splits the sequence across list boundaries: each page carries the node and view, the concatenated pages equal the --all answer in order, the last page has no next_cursor, and a bad cursor or out-of-range limit exits 2; why --json and api call why print the same bytes; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza why computes its whole walk, then pages decisions, then sources, then change sets as one sequence with --limit counting entries across all three, an opaque --cursor naming the list and offset, and --all; node and view come on every page
